The organization of space is key to every great design, providing **consistent rhythm** to all our products._ Our spatial system is built on design tokens generated by Style Dictionary. These tokens provide consistent spacing, sizing, radii, and border widths across all components. ## Spacing Spacing tokens are used for margins, paddings, and gaps between elements.

It allows you to build interfaces with a look and feel that combines a touch of user-friendly, contemporary, fresh, and timeless design. We will use the typeface at various weights, primarily _Light [300]_, _Regular [400]_, _Semibold [600]_, and _Bold [700]_. **Note**: Each variation has a `@mixin` available for use.
